question: Should Nextcloud Talk make parsed rich-object text, rather than the raw webhook JSON envelope, the permanent agent-facing input contract for structured messages?
rationale: The implementation is plugin-local and follows the upstream payload format, but it deliberately changes what existing agents receive for structured messages and how non-command rich-object text is separated from command parsing.

options.title: Accept plugin-local normalization
options.body: Merge after confirming that rendered message text and the sanitized command body are the desired stable input contract for Talk agents.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Ask for a smaller parser contract that preserves additional raw rich-object context before accepting a change to agent-visible message content.

recommendation.title: Accept plugin-local normalization
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming that rendered message text and the sanitized command body are the desired stable input contract for Talk agents.
